entities.summary: Tolu Ogunlesi (b. 1982-03-03, Edinburgh) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Edinburgh and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, painters & sculptors, africa.
